title: Function tool call output
description: The output of a function tool call.

agent.description: The agent that produced this item.

id.description:
The unique ID of the function tool call output. Populated when this item
is returned via API.

type.description: The type of the function tool call output. Always `function_call_output`.

call_id.description: The unique ID of the function tool call generated by the model.

name.description: The name of the tool that produced the output.

namespace.description: The namespace of the tool that produced the output.

output.description:
The output from the function call generated by your code.
Can be a string or an list of output content.

oneOf.description: A string of the output of the function call.
oneOf.title: string output
output content list
oneOf.description: Text, image, or file output of the function call.

status.description:
The status of the item. One of `in_progress`, `completed`, or
`incomplete`. Populated when items are returned via API.
